raw_text: [[File:{{{Alt}}}|28px|link=]] "Increases the speed, range, and power of the Minion Prince's first few attacks" Contents 1 Summary 2 Strategies 2.1 Offensive Strategies 2.2 Defensive Strategies 3 Statistics 4 Audio 4.1 Generic 4.2 Unique 5 History 6 Trivia 6.1 Comparisons Summary The Noble Iron is a piece of Common Hero Equipment for the Minion Prince . It is unlocked when the Blacksmith is upgraded to level 5, which requires Town Hall 12 to do so. The Noble Iron is a passive Hero Equipment that appears to be a dumbbell with a brass bar and crown-shaped end, and iron weights bolted on each end. When equipped, it increases the range and damage of the first few shots of the Minion Prince after he is deployed and modify his shots into a big purplish iron fist. In addition to the ability, the Noble Iron grants additional attack speed and hitpoints to the Minion Prince. Strategies Offensive Strategies Pairing up with the Angry Jelly allows Minion Prince to work similarly as Royal Champion with Rocket Spear or Flame Flinger with a massive range, allow him to snipe defenses from afar. With Metal Pants , since it is an active ability that recover a large amount of hitpoints and reduce damage taken by a lot, it can extends the Minion Prince Charge to clear out more from a corner of the base. In addition to the above pairing, one can add Air Mode Grand Warden into the charge as he will attack the same target with the Minion Prince and may help provide some passive bonus based on his own Equipment, and both can be recalled after the charge is finished. While Grand Warden have more range than Minion Prince normally and stays safe behind him, it is not true when the Noble Iron ability is active, be careful to not let him be target first. Defensive Strategies At level 12 and above, only the Inferno Artillery , Firespitters , Long Range Multi-Gear Tower , and Longshot can match or outrange the Minion Prince with Noble Iron, which renders him vulnerable, especially when exposed. While the Eagle Artillery can also target him when Noble Iron is active, he most likely is deployed at the start of the attack so it will remain inactive. Even when he is deployed later when it is active to help with the back end, the Eagle Artillery will likely target the main army instead. Increased attack speed increase by 1% at all levels. Trivia When initially unlocked and when equipped, the Minion Prince attacks every 0.802 seconds, and when maxed out, his attack speed is 0.720 seconds. Comparisons The Noble Iron and Healer Puppet , and Vampstache and Metal Pants are the only Common Equipment to be unlocked at the same Blacksmith level, at level 5 and 3 respectively. The Noble Iron and Rocket Spear works similarly, both increases the attack damage and range temporarily, with Rocket Spear being an active ability while Noble Iron will always be used at the start of the attack. The Noble Iron also makes Minion Prince acts like a Super Minion , with a temporary extended range when deployed.
